readerCopy.headline: You have more room to be seen.
readerCopy.body:
Work may get a warmer response. People may trust your direction more quickly. You may find it easier to take credit for something you actually did or step into a role that already fits. The recognition can feel less like a fight and more like other people finally seeing what was already there.

Jupiter trine Sun is a good time to submit the work, ask for the credit, or take the place you have already earned. Enjoy the recognition. It is not a reason to give every audience permanent access to you.
doNotAssume: Do not assume fame, promotion, universal approval, or permanent success.
